note: Bootstrap cycle — 11 international sources reconned in one pass. Sources requiring headless flagged with headless_likely_needed=true.

sources.data_type: VN macro indicators (GDP, CPI, PMI, trade balance)
sources.notes: Free API key needed for JSON download; public HTML pages scraped without key. Requires ASP.NET_SessionId cookie.
v8 chart API fully open — no auth, no bot protection. v7 quote API requires auth (skip). Best source for FX rates.
DataDome hard block (401, x-datadome:protected, x-dd-b:3). RSS fallback recommended first: https://feeds.reuters.com/reuters/businessNews

sources.data_type: Markets news headlines (subscription paywall for full content)
sources.notes: PerimeterX passive phase at first load (200 returned). Subscription paywall blocks data; only free headlines accessible. PX active challenge triggers on subsequent requests.

sources.data_type: IMF macro forecasts (GDP growth, inflation, current account) for VN
sources.notes: www.imf.org DataMapper API blocked by Akamai (403). Alternative: probe api.imf.org WEO API — different domain, may be open. Recommend separate recon for api.imf.org before investing in Botasaurus.

sources.data_type: VN annual macro data (GDP, CPI, FDI, trade, unemployment) via open API
sources.notes: Fully open REST API. No auth. JSON format. Use mrv=N param for most recent N years. Best open source for VN annual macro data.

sources.data_type: ADB Key Indicators for Vietnam (GDP, trade, social indicators)
sources.notes: SPA — correct internal API endpoints unknown. Playwright needed to intercept XHR calls and discover API. No bot protection once API is known. Bulk Excel downloads available without login as fallback.

sources.data_type: Global economic calendar events (VN + US + global releases with forecast/actual/previous)
sources.notes: CF __cf_bm passive mode (200 returned). Calendar data via POST to /economic-calendar/Service/getCalendarFilteredData. cloudscraper/curl_cffi should obtain session cookie. Vietnam country code needs discovery.

sources.data_type: US macro data (Fed rate, VIX, yield curve, CPI, USD index)
sources.notes: API key required (free, instant registration). api.stlouisfed.org has NO bot protection. Web pages blocked by Akamai (irrelevant). Action needed: provision FRED_API_KEY in .env.
VN Index NOT tracked on MarketWatch (/investing/index/vni redirects to German stock). Useful for US market indices news text only. WSJ API available but VNI not in universe. Low priority.

sources.data_type: US/global market indices via quote API + world markets news
sources.notes: Clean 200 delivery, no bot protection. Quote API (quote.cnbc.com) is open JSON. VN Index not in CNBC symbol universe. Best for US/global index quotes and market news headlines.
